messages:
lee_cs: Weekly health check for Meridian 1: tokens +9% WoW (QoQ +2%), requests/s down 22% WoW (295 -> 230 r/s), avg gen latency up ~160ms (360 -> 520ms), error rate spiked to 1.8% (baseline ~0.3%), spend +18% MoM (median seq 720 -> 1,150). Onboarding: cohort 4 moving to prod next week. Renewal risk: medium -- Ana has a call Fri. Need infra help to investigate throughput regression and error spikes. Dashboard: https://redwood.internal/grafana/meridian/weekly :mag_right:

devon_sre: Copy. Initial look: CPU pressure on medium workers (worker-14) Tue 09:00-11:30 UTC, GC thrash observed. Autoscaler didn't add nodes because policy currently min=max. Will audit scaling policy and worker logs.

priya_data: Telemetry quick view: 90% tokens on rwd-chat-medium, 12% of requests hit rwd-chat-large during long sessions. Tail latency correlates strongly with seq_len > 900. Percentiles: p50=420ms, p90=820ms, p99=1.6s.

lee_cs: Any change to batching or cache hit-rate that could explain the drop in throughput?

devon_sre: Batching config unchanged. Cache hit-rate fell from 78% -> 61% starting Monday, likely due to appended user context in recent client release. Grabbing cache traces now.

priya_data: Also seeing more concurrent open sessions during US daytime windows which increases KV residency and eviction churn.

lee_cs: Can you paste a short worker log snippet around the spike?

devon_sre: Log snippet: ```
2026-03-18T09:12:34Z worker=worker-14 cpu=92% model=rwd-chat-medium seq_len=1280 latency=1600ms error=timeout req=req_z12
2026-03-18T09:12:35Z worker=worker-14 memory=78% cache_miss=true req=req_z13
2026-03-18T09:13:02Z autoscaler=policy-34 current_nodes=8 desired_nodes=8 reason=min-max-lock
```

ana_sales: (ana_sales) I'll pause renewal nudges until we see stabilization. Preparing Fri call notes.

billing-bot: Alert: Meridian MTD spend +18% vs prior month. Billing contact: ana_sales@meridian.co

devon_sre: Proposed actions: 1) temporarily increase autoscaler min from 8 -> 12 for 24h trial (devon_sre) 2) prefer rwd-chat-medium for seq > 700 to avoid small-model thrash (devon_sre + infra) 3) priya_data to run 1hr synthetic load with 1k-1.5k seqs to measure throughput and tail latency (priya_data) 4) CS to update customer playbook + onboarding slide noting transcript behavior (lee_cs)

priya_data: Synthetic job queued: syn-276543-1. ETA ~45m. Will post p50/p90/p99 and trace links.

devon_sre: I'll stage autoscaler change in staging, publish rollback runbook here before prod tweak.

lee_cs: Thanks. After synthetic & autoscale test we'll reconvene Tue AM with tokens, throughput, errors, and spend delta. Action owners and due dates in the wiki: https://redwood.internal/wiki/meridian-health. :white_check_mark:
